headline: Marban Hollow and Weathered Expanse Recover Works as Godcrofts Burns
war_summary:
The lines have turned once more since the last edition. Marban Hollow, which now stands at four Warden works, three Colonial and one unclaimed, has reversed the Colonial gain reported three hours past; Checkpoint Bua remains the chief scene, bearing twenty-five of the region's thirty-eight actions in the day, six of them within the last two hours.

Weathered Expanse has drawn one work back out of no man's land, leaving six Warden and three unclaimed, though its forty actions of the day have gone quiet in the past two hours. Palantine Berm has likewise restored a Warden work, now four Colonial against three Warden with none unclaimed; forty-five actions in the day, four in two hours, keep Vendett and Windburn Landing in dispute. Linn Mercy reads eight Colonial, two Warden and one neutral, with Lathair and Outwich Ranch the busiest ground.

Godcrofts has flared hottest of all — eleven actions in two hours and thirty-five in six — about Isawa, Fleecewatch and Ursa Base, where three works lie unclaimed. Callahan's Passage reports no change of works, and Stlican Shelf holds at one Warden, seven Colonial and one neutral. The victory mark stands at thirty-four towns.
